findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe XML parser configurations in lxml
 * @description Finding unsafe XML parser configurations that could enable XXE attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-xml-parser-config
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Looking for parser creation without safe defaults
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["XMLParser", "ETCompatXMLParser"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml.etree").getMember(["XMLParser", "ETCompatXMLParser"]).getACall()
select call, "XML parser created without explicit safe configuration. Consider disabling DTD processing and external entities to prevent XXE attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe XML parser configurations that could enable XXE attacks
